clause: Panel group — Calibration + develop process version [STU-RAW-012]

scope.summary: Add the Calibration group: the develop process version (the versioned rendering model governing demosaic + adjustment math) as a first-class field; Shadow tint calibration; and Red/Green/Blue primary hue + saturation calibration. Changing the process version is an EXPLICIT, RECEIPTED operation because it alters reproducibility ([STU-RAW-001]); imported documents MUST record their originating process version and MUST NOT be silently re-rendered under a newer version without an operator/model-visible migration receipt.
acceptance_criteria: calibration params + first-class process version; version change receipted; no silent re-render
expected_tests: test: process version is first-class field; calibration params apply
test: process-version change emits migration receipt; imported doc keeps origin version, no silent re-render

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Calibration & process version

risk_if_missed: Silent process-version drift breaks reproducibility guarantee.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
